spec.title: OpenWrt - Advanced Monitoring
spec.description: Optional profile dashboard for OpenWrt nftables traffic, WiFi mesh, Netifyd DPI, and data quality.

options.content:
## Advanced OpenWrt monitoring
Profile-aware views for per-device nftables traffic, WiFi mesh signals, and optional Netifyd DPI. Missing profiles are shown as unavailable.

spec.title: Traffic Profile
spec.description: Read-only nftables per-device counters. Green requires both the collector flag and a successful exporter scrape of that collector. Enable the traffic or full router profile.

spec.title: WiFi Mesh Profile
spec.description: Optional radio and usteer mesh metrics. Green requires both the collector flag and a successful exporter scrape. Enable the wifi_mesh or full router profile.

spec.title: DPI Profile
spec.description: Optional Netifyd status snapshot metrics. Reads 0 when the snapshot is missing or older than 5 minutes, so a wedged Netifyd is not shown as healthy.

spec.title: Tracked Devices
spec.description: Current device identities discovered from the DHCP lease map and nftables sets.

spec.title: Tracked Device Traffic
spec.description: Traffic rate from nftables counters. Hostnames are bounded and selected from DHCP leases.

spec.title: WiFi Radio Signal
spec.description: Radio transmit power. This is an RF configuration signal, not client RSSI.

spec.title: Top Tracked Devices
spec.description: Bounded top-10 device traffic ranking. It is descriptive, not a health score.

spec.title: DPI Active Flows
spec.description: Netifyd status snapshot values. No data means the DPI profile is not installed or has no readable status snapshot.

options.content:
## Per-device traffic
The router installs accept-policy nftables counters before the normal forwarding path. Broadcast and multicast are excluded. Counters are read through `nft -j` on the router; no privileged exporter binary is required.

spec.title: Upload and Download by Device
spec.description: Per-device byte rate. Use the Device variable to focus the chart when the router has many leases.

spec.title: Device Identity
spec.description: Hostname-first identity labels with bounded IP and MAC metadata.

spec.title: Packets by Direction
spec.description: Packet rate from the same nftables counters. Large gaps can indicate a counter-set reload or lease churn.

spec.title: Traffic Counter Series
spec.description: Current byte-counter series for the selected router and device filter.

spec.title: Traffic Collector
spec.description: Explicit collector state. A value of 0 means the profile, JSON dependency, or nftables set is unavailable.

spec.title: Traffic Packets
spec.description: Aggregate packet rate for the selected device filter.

spec.title: Traffic Bytes
spec.description: Aggregate byte rate for the selected device filter.

options.content:
## WiFi mesh
Radio settings use low-cardinality labels. usteer metrics are emitted only when usteer is present and exposes local_info. Client hearing maps remain intentionally outside the default profile to bound MAC cardinality.

spec.title: Mesh Collector
spec.description: Whether the optional Lua mesh collector loaded its ubus and iwinfo dependencies and completed its scrape.

spec.title: Associated Clients
spec.description: Associated clients reported by usteer local_info. Zero can be a valid empty mesh state.

spec.title: Mesh Load
spec.description: Local usteer load value when available.

spec.title: Radios
spec.description: Radios with channel data from iwinfo.

spec.title: Radio Channel and Frequency
spec.description: Current channel and center frequency per radio interface.

spec.title: Radio TX Power
spec.description: Configured radio transmit power and calibration offset.

spec.title: WiFi Security and Roaming Features
spec.description: 802.11r/k/v settings per configured wireless interface.

spec.title: usteer Roam Events
spec.description: Cumulative roam event values reported by usteer local_info.

spec.title: Associated Clients by AP
spec.description: Current associated client count by usteer AP label.

options.content:
## DPI and data quality
The DPI collector reads `/var/run/netifyd/status.json` and exports only top bounded application/protocol entries. Netifyd does not replace Prometheus traffic counters; it adds application context when installed.

spec.title: DPI Collector
spec.description: 1 means the router read a fresh Netifyd snapshot and completed the scrape. 0 means missing, stale, or failed - all explicit unavailable states.

spec.title: Active DPI Flows
spec.description: Current active flows from the Netifyd snapshot.

spec.title: DPI Devices
spec.description: Current devices reported in the Netifyd snapshot.

spec.title: Application Series
spec.description: Bounded application series currently exported by the router.

spec.title: Top Applications by Bytes
spec.description: Top bounded application byte values from Netifyd. Snapshot values may move down when flows expire.

spec.title: Top Protocols by Flows
spec.description: Top bounded protocol flow counts from Netifyd.

spec.title: Collector Availability
spec.description: Profile availability over time. This distinguishes a disabled profile from a broken primary scrape.

spec.title: Exporter Collector Health
spec.description: Official Lua exporter collector success state. Investigate this before treating a missing optional metric as a dashboard defect.

spec.title: Textfile Freshness
spec.description: Age of helper-generated textfile metrics. This is separate from Lua profile availability.

spec.title: Prometheus Scrape
spec.description: Primary router scrape reachability.

spec.title: DPI Application Flow Series
spec.description: Application flow series currently available from the snapshot.

spec.title: Profile Metrics
spec.description: Current count of optional profile metric series. Use the panels above to identify which profile is absent.
